opportunities.title: NCI Pathway to Independence Award (K99/R00 Clinical Trial Required)
opportunities.description: Supports talented postdoctoral researchers with a research or clinical doctorate transitioning from mentored postdoctoral research to independent tenure-track positions, with an NCI cancer research project.
opportunities.other_eligibility: Verify doctorate timing, remaining K99 eligibility window, citizenship/visa rules, mentor and clinical-trial requirements in the full announcement.

opportunities.title: Secondary Analysis and Integration of Existing Data to Elucidate Cancer Risk and Related Outcomes (R01 Clinical Trial Not Allowed)
opportunities.description: Innovative secondary analysis and integration of existing genomic, omics, clinical, EHR, imaging, environmental and population data for cancer risk and outcomes. Includes oral and oropharyngeal cancer, advanced statistical or computational methods, and integration of multiple data types.
opportunities.other_eligibility: R01 PD/PI and institutional submission eligibility must be confirmed; deadline shown is the next new-application date in the official notice.

opportunities.title: NIDA Animal Genomics Program (U01 Clinical Trial Not Allowed)
opportunities.description: Genomics, multi-omics, artificial intelligence and machine learning approaches using animal models to study genetic and epigenetic mechanisms across substance use disorder trajectories.
opportunities.other_eligibility: Requires an animal-genomics program aligned to NIDA; included as a deliberate lower-fit/eligibility-review contrast.
